=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasko-4]] is assessed at 96% (proved). The Connecticut Births and Christenings extraction names Lucy, born 13 June 1809 at Griswold, as Isaac Glasko’s daughter, FHL 2917. The distinctive surname/locality match Isaac’s blacksmith family without requiring his upstream ancestry.
